```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
      with:
        rust-version-file: 'rust-toolchain.toml'

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version-file: '.node-version'
        cache: 'pnpm'

    - name: Install pnpm
      run: npm install -g pnpm@10.13.1

    - name: Install just
      run: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://just.systems/install.sh | sh

    - name: Install cargo-binstall
      run: cargo install cargo-binstall@latest

    - name: Install development tools
      run: just init

    - name: Install Node.js dependencies
      run: pnpm install

    - name: Verify tool installations
      run: |
        rustc --version
        node --version
        pnpm --version
        just --version
        cargo-binstall --version
        watchexec-cli --version
        cargo-insta --version
        typos-cli --version
        cargo-shear --version
        dprint --version

    - name: Check build environment
      run: cargo check

    - name: Completion message
      run: echo "Setup complete. Available commands: just ready, just fmt, just test, just lint"
```
